76881.subject: AVALANCHE JULY 2026 RECAP
76881.body:
View this post on the web at https://www.team1.blog/p/avalanche-july-2026-recap

July 2026 was Avalanche’s production moment. Hyundai Card and Hyundai Motor Company moved their cross-border stablecoin remittance system into production on Avalanche. Tokenized value on the network grew from $1.6 billion to $1.9 billion in a single month, pushing Avalanche’s overall RWA market past $13.5 billion and moving it from seventh to fifth on RWA.xyz’s rankings. BlackRock’s BUIDL fund surpassed $900 million in AUM, up 105% in a week, while tokenized US Treasuries climbed 76% to $843 million.
On the builder side, Team1 launched Accelerator and Mini Grants, named a ten-person grants committee, and approved its first grant to YourGrails.
Want to keep up with the latest in the Avalanche ecosystem? Subscribe to the Team1 blog and get our updates in your inbox weekly.
Helicon Activates on Fuji Testnet:
Helicon activated on Fuji Testnet, bringing Continuous Execution to the C-Chain. [Helicon [ https://substack.com/redirect/a9c3fbe0-9808-41b4-b1dc-f1d29f8ca5ba?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Staking Participation Climbs to 41.5%:
41.5% of all AVAX is now staked, with the network’s dual mechanism paying stakers in newly minted AVAX while burning every transaction fee. [Staking [ https://substack.com/redirect/85b9e852-0022-405d-8cd6-30775a769c06?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Foundation Unveils Economic Research Agenda:
The Avalanche Foundation published its Economic Research Agenda, laying out the questions guiding its ongoing work on tokenomics and network economics. [Research Agenda [ https://substack.com/redirect/c41d1c71-4907-4440-96e1-8129f0d0c1ec?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Distributed Asset Value Hits New ATH:
Avalanche’s distributed asset value reached a new all-time high of $2.1 billion this month. [ATH [ https://substack.com/redirect/879d5393-2caa-4ab8-9de1-e5770a058283?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
ACP-285 Discussed Across Community and Ecosystem Calls:
The community caught up on ACP-285 throughout the month, covering the proposed reduction to the minimum consumption rate. [Recording [ https://substack.com/redirect/87199dcc-aeab-46b4-b72b-82e668e36764?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]] | [Call Recap [ https://substack.com/redirect/a03e5d2b-2575-485b-b4af-be0a4ad463e3?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
Team1 Onboards New Collaborators:
Emails went out to new Team1 collaborators after the community reviewed more than 3,000 applications from over 80 countries submitted the previous month. [Collaborators [ https://substack.com/redirect/4878d753-d174-4a4e-98f5-5fab873cc4f6?j=eyJ1IjoiMXN4Zm00In0.wehL2Vke0PUDz1PHD6ZKtcy1ufIoeqpblecCEEWPpqI ]]
